description: This file contains cryptographic functions related to safe prime generation, big number operations, and modular arithmetic, specifically for the SRP (Secure Remote Password) authentication protocol. It includes prime testing, safe prime generation, and big number utilities.

methods.name: trialdiv
methods.description: Performs trial division to check if a number is divisible by small primes less than 256.

methods.name: sophie_germain
methods.description: Generates a Sophie-Germain prime within a specified range.

methods.name: t_makeconfent
methods.description: Generates a configuration entry with a safe prime and generator for cryptographic use.

methods.name: t_makeconfent_c
methods.description: Generates a configuration entry with a safe prime and generator using a different method, suitable for larger key sizes.

methods.name: t_newconfent
methods.description: Initializes a new configuration entry with default values.

methods.name: t_putconfent
methods.description: Outputs a configuration entry to a file in base64-encoded format.

methods.name: BigIntegerBitLen
methods.description: Returns the bit length of a BigInteger.

methods.name: BigIntegerCheckPrime
methods.description: Checks if a BigInteger is prime using a probabilistic test.

methods.name: BigIntegerModInt
methods.description: Computes the modulus of a BigInteger with an unsigned int.

methods.name: BigIntegerMod
methods.description: Computes the modulus of a BigInteger with another BigInteger.

methods.name: BigIntegerLShift
methods.description: Performs a left shift on a BigInteger.
